range.menu.intro: Choose a weapon, pick a drill, read the four steps, then press Start. Work from Learn through Practice to Challenge.
range.drill-unavailable: This challenge needs the range weapon adapter to be available.
range.guide.holster: Start with your weapon holstered. Keep it holstered through the countdown.
range.guide.empty: Start with an empty weapon and a spare magazine. Wait for the beep.
range.guide.ready: Take your place behind the firing bench with the listed weapon ready.
range.guide.wait: Wait for the overhead countdown and start beep. Then shoot the raised plates.
range.guide.draw: After the beep: press Tab to draw, aim, then shoot.
range.guide.reload: After the beep: press R, finish reloading, then shoot.
range.guide.shoot: Use {weapon}. Aim for {zone}. Land {hits} scoring hit(s) on each plate.
range.guide.priority: Use {weapon}. Shoot lane {lane} first; follow the next called lane.
range.guide.contact: Use {weapon}. Keep contact on each plate for {seconds}s.
range.guide.next: Follow each new target wave. A plate drops when its required hits are complete.
range.guide.transition: Switch weapons when the overhead display calls for the next one: {weapons}.
range.guide.noSilent: A real hit outside the called zone or priority shows a red explanation and earns no target points.
range.records.fair: Speed and accuracy records require every plate cleared, with no missed plates. Records are separate for each drill and weapon setup.
range.records.noClean: Clear every plate to set speed and accuracy records. Your score records are kept.
range.monitor.title: PGB RANGE / DRILL BOARD
range.monitor.choose: Select a drill at the range console. Watch the overhead board for the countdown, instructions and final score.
range.monitor.watch: Watch the overhead board. Wait for the beep.
range.monitor.beep: Wait for the beep. Shoot the raised targets after GO.
range.monitor.retry: Use the range console to retry or choose another drill.
range.reason.early-draw: Weapon drawn before the beep. Keep it holstered during the countdown.
range.drill.pistol.first-steps.name: First Five
range.drill.pistol.first-steps.objective: Five close plates, one at a time. Any scoring zone counts; take your time and learn the range.
range.drill.pistol.draw-ready.name: Draw on the Beep
range.drill.pistol.draw-ready.objective: Start holstered. After the beep, draw with Tab and clear one close plate.
range.drill.m4.reload-ready.name: Reload and Engage
range.drill.m4.reload-ready.objective: Start empty. After the beep, reload with R, then land two scoring hits on one close plate.
range.drill.pistol.pistol-rifle.name: Pistol / Rifle Relay
range.drill.pistol.pistol-rifle.objectiv: Six single-plate stages alternate pistol and carbine. Follow the weapon call before firing.
range.drill.shotgun.three-gun.name: Three-Gun Circuit
range.drill.shotgun.three-gun.objective: Nine close stages cycle pistol, carbine and shotgun. Switch to the called weapon and clear each plate.
